sections.description: The speaker introduces believing as comprising two main ideas: viewing the customer as an asset from the start and recognizing that how you begin the relationship drives future growth.
sections.title: Two core ideas of believing

sections.title: Suspending cynicism and hardwiring belief into culture

summary: In this succinct clip from Jeanne Bliss’s Beloved Companies framework, the speaker defines believing as two intertwined commitments: first, to treat the customer as an asset from the outset and to carefully punctuate that opening relationship because it shapes growth; second, to suspend cynicism and hardwire belief into the organizational culture, including efforts to address the needs of the minority. The final emphasis is on empowering employees through training and education so they can believe in their work and be believed in, forming the foundation of a culture where customers and staff are valued as essential assets.
title: Belief as Asset: Customer-first Mindset and Training for a Culture of Belief
topics: believe and be believed in the job
